Theorem
[Strict Gromov rigidity] \group mostow ↗ thurston-ch06-degree-volume Source: thurston:page-0143

Let $f:M_1\to M_2$ be a nonzero-degree map between closed oriented hyperbolic $3$-manifolds. If $v(M_1)=|\deg f|v(M_2)$, then $f$ is homotopic to a local isometry; for degree $\pm 1$ it is a homotopy equivalence, and otherwise it is homotopic to a covering map.
